column1: # feature-t3-known-red.tsv — the T3 pairs that DO NOT COMPILE today, with the symptom.
# THIS FILE IS A RATCHET, NOT A PLACE TO HIDE. scripts/feature-t3-sweep.sh judges every sweep
# against it IN BOTH DIRECTIONS:
#   * a T3 pair that FAILS and is not listed here  -> RED. A new break.
#   * a pair listed here that now COMPILES         -> RED. Remove the row; the list must shrink.
# and the number of rows is CEILINGED in the sweep script, in reviewed code (MAX_KNOWN_RED), so a
# regression cannot be absorbed by appending. The second direction is the one that matters: a
# hand-kept list of known problems only ever grows on its own, and a list that only grows stops
# describing the tree — which is how a "debt ledger" comes to pass while describing an object that
# no longer exists.
# WHY THERE IS ANYTHING HERE AT ALL. Until 2026-07-26 nothing in CI compiled these pairs. The
# first sweep over a surface nobody had fed to rustc in months found real, pre-existing breakage.
# Recording it is how the sweep becomes a gate today instead of a wish; every row is a FINDING
# handed to the next lane, not an excuse. Reporting them and exiting 0 would have been a
# fail-open gate, which this repository has a whole memory note about.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; blank lines and '#' comments ignored)
#   crate    cargo package name
#   feature  the feature name
#   symptom  the FIRST `error...` line rustc emitted, or `TIMEOUT after Ns`
# ── THE FIRST MEASUREMENT (2026-07-26, hbox, 24 cores, warm lane, no Lean archive so the
#    dregg-lean-ffi build script early-returns exactly as it does on a hosted runner) ──
# 79 T3 pairs: 59 PASS, 20 FAIL, 1594s total (26.6 min), mean 20s, median 12s, max 151s
# (starbridge-v2:gpui-web). FIVE distinct root causes, not twenty problems:
#   1. deos-hermes x4 — ⚑ FIXED 2026-07-27, rows deleted. `examples/agent_turn_carries_a_web_fact.rs`
#      imported the live github prover unconditionally, so it compiled in ci.yml ONLY because
#      another member pulled `tlsn-live` into the unified resolve — its compilability was a
#      function of the PACKAGE SELECTION and nothing said so. It now declares
#      `required-features = ["zk-live"]`, the stanza its sibling `zk_live_carrier` always had,
#      and the live backend it wants is the `dregg-zkoracle-live` CRATE rather than a feature
#      that reaches into a shared one. The predicted "one missing `[[example]]` stanza fixes
#      all four" held exactly.
#   2. pg-dregg x6 + dregg-sdk-py x3 — `unresolved imports p3_fri::{CpuTwoAdicFriFold,
#      TwoAdicFriFoldBackend}`. Both are EXCLUDED workspaces, so neither inherits the root's
#      `[patch] p3-fri = { path = "vendor/plonky3-fri-82cfad73" }`; they resolve a different
#      p3-fri and dregg-circuit-prove does not build there. ⚠ `publish-sdk-py.yml` runs
#      `cargo test --manifest-path sdk-py/Cargo.toml` on an `sdk-py-v*` TAG — so the next wheel
#      cut fails, and nothing said so.
#   3. dregg-tests x2 — the `__legacy_tests` / `__wip_tests` features are pure API drift:
#      `dregg_circuit::{BodyMembershipProof, MultiStepWitness}` are gone, and
#      `dregg_cell::Cell::id` is now private. Textbook `#![cfg]` rot.
#   4. dreggnet-market:authenticated-clearing + dreggnet-telegram:private-bazaar-live — a struct
#      grew a field (`BfvPublicIdentity::opening_threshold`) and a function grew an argument,
#      and the feature-gated call sites were never recompiled.
#   5. starbridge-v2:sel4-thin — `unresolved import starbridge_v2::session` under its OWN
#      documented invocation (`--no-default-features --features sel4-thin`).
# ⚠ TWO ROWS ARE HOST-DEPENDENT AND MUST BE RE-MEASURED FROM THE FIRST CI ARTIFACT.
# `deos-zed-full`'s two pairs failed at `glib-sys`'s build script because the measuring host had
# no `pkg-config glib-2.0`. feature-surface.yml's apt line now installs libglib2.0-dev/libgtk-3-dev/
# libatk1.0-dev/libsoup-3.0-dev, so the hosted shard may well get further — in which case the
# sweep goes RED on the "now COMPILES but is still recorded broken" direction, which is the
# ratchet working. Fix by replacing these two rows with whatever CI actually reports.
